list.title: Website content
list.caption: Public pages by language
list.intro: Edit the text of the public pages in English and Urdu. Saving keeps a private draft; visitors only see what you publish.

editor.title: Edit {page}
editor.bodyHelp: Write plain text, or use the simple Markdown below. HTML is not allowed: any tags are removed when the page is shown.

syntax.heading: ## Heading section heading
syntax.paragraph: Leave a blank line to start a new paragraph.

editor.saved: Draft saved. The public page has not changed.
editor.published: Published. Visitors now see this version.
editor.unpublished: Unpublished. The page is no longer on the public site.
editor.publishBody: Visitors will see this {language} text on the public site straight away. Unsaved edits are saved first.
editor.unpublishBody: The {language} page is removed from the public site straight away. Your draft is kept.
editor.unpublishedChangesNotice: This draft has changes that are not live yet. Publish to update the public page.
editor.missingTranslationNotice: There is no Urdu text yet. Visitors to the Urdu site see the English page until an Urdu version is published.
editor.errorSave: The draft could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
editor.errorPublishEmpty: Add a title or body before publishing.
editor.errorGeneric: That did not work. Reload the page and try again.

preview.banner: Private draft preview. Not visible to the public.
preview.missingNotice: There is no Urdu text yet. Visitors see the English page instead.
preview.empty: This draft has no title or body yet.

events.title: Events
events.caption: Events in the content manager
events.intro: Plan events in English and Urdu. Saving keeps a private draft; the public Events page only shows what you publish.

empty.title: No events yet
empty.body: Create an event to draft it privately, then publish it to the public Events page.

editor.pktNote: Enter times in Pakistan time (PKT, UTC+5). They are stored in UTC and shown here in Pakistan time.
editor.saved: Draft saved. The public Events page has not changed.
editor.published: Published. The event is now on the public Events page.
editor.unpublished: Unpublished. The event is no longer on the public site.
editor.publishBody: Visitors will see this event on the public Events page straight away. Unsaved edits are saved first.
editor.unpublishBody: The event is removed from the public Events page straight away. Your draft is kept.
editor.errorGeneric: That did not work. Reload the page and try again.
editor.errorFields: Some details need attention. Check the highlighted fields.
editor.errorEndsBeforeStart: The end time cannot be before the start time.
editor.errorRequiredToPublish: Needed before the event can be published.
editor.unpublishedChangesNotice: This draft has changes that are not live yet. Publish to update the public Events page.
